topic: What antenna aperture size trade-offs exist between LEO and GEO satellites when optimizing gain and portability for CMOS-based ground terminals?
consensus_response: The trade-offs between LEO and GEO satellites for CMOS-based ground terminals center around antenna aperture size, gain, and portability. LEO satellites offer higher gain and smaller antenna apertures on the ground, but require more complex adaptive antennas for tracking. GEO satellites have lower gain, necessitate larger ground antennas, yet offer simpler designs and fixed coverage areas. The choice between LEO and GEO depends on application requirements, with LEO better suited for low latency and high data rate applications, and GEO for constant coverage over fixed locations.
